主要内容: On January 18, 2012, Henry Schein, Inc. amended the terms of certain Amended and Restated Change in Control Agreements dated December 12, 2008, including those between the company and James Breslawski, Stanley Komaroff, Mark Mlotek, and Steven Paladino. The amendments, effective as of January 1, 2012, include: (1) changing the basis of pro rata incentive compensation upon certain terminations in connection with a change in control to be based on actual results for the year of termination rather than target incentive compensation; (2) eliminating a tax gross-up for health benefits; and (3) replacing the gross-up payment for golden parachute excise taxes under Internal Revenue Code Section 4999 with a contingent cut-back, where amounts payable in connection with a change in control are reduced to a safe harbor limit to avoid triggering excise taxes, unless the amounts due would be greater, in which case no reduction occurs. The amendments apply to executive officers including James Breslawski, Stanley Komaroff, Mark Mlotek, and Steven Paladino. The summary is qualified by the Form of Amendment, attached as Exhibit 10.1 and incorporated by reference. The changes affect the company's compensation structure and tax implications for executive officers in the healthcare distribution industry.
